title: Online Orders 10/10 hub
summary: The Online Orders screen gets a polished empty state, platform and status filters, one-click webhook copy, platform-picker demos, and clearer order cards for Zomato, Swiggy, and ONDC.
highlights: Empty state: platform chips, 3-step flow (webhook → Accept+KOT → POS), clearer CTAs.
Clickable New / Preparing / Ready stats plus All · Swiggy · Zomato · ONDC filters.
Webhook modal with copy URL, setup steps, and sample JSON payload.
Demo order lets you pick Swiggy, Zomato, or ONDC instead of a random platform.
Order cards: item bullets, tappable phone, POS label, double-click guard on Accept, Listening status + last refreshed.
